success_condition: The exported official Gaussian bitstream parses as 32-bit address/data entries and its 16-bit native IO placement is explicit: inputs x={0,2}, outputs x={1,3}.
failure_policy: If the trace or placement drifts, regenerate from the pinned image and use the new metadata; do not hard-code a 512-bit lane mapping or merge the 17-bit data and 1-bit control paths.
